sources.title: The Korea Times: SK Innovation NCM811 batteries for Genesis G80 EV and Kia EV6 (2021-04-20)
sources.notes: "Both the G80 and the EV6 utilize SK Innovation batteries" (unnamed industry official); "The two batteries are SK Innovation's NCM811 batteries"; G80 EV with SK's 87.2 kWh pack.

sources.title: Mobility Engineering Tech (SAE Media): Hub-Motoring in Lordstown's Novel Endurance
sources.notes: "The hub motors operate on 370V nominal", 109-kWh pack, LG Chem lithium-ion cells; chemistry and thermal management not stated.

sources.title: Auto-Data.net: Lexus TZ 450e 95.82 kWh 308 Hp DIRECT4
sources.notes: Gross 95.82 kWh, battery voltage 385 V, Li-Ion. No usable, no chemistry.

sources.title: GreenCars: 2027 Toyota Highlander EV reveal
sources.notes: 95.8 kWh pack: new pouch cells from LG Energy Solution with a nickel-manganese-cobalt-aluminum cathode similar to GM Ultium. Toyota gives no chemistry or voltage. Lexus TZ lists the same 95.82 kWh pack as the Highlander.

battery.chemistry.notes: Korea Times (2021): G80 EV carries the SK 87.2 kWh pack, "SK Innovation's NCM811 batteries" (industry official, not Genesis). Corroborated for the later 94.5 kWh pack by the Genesis Korea notice (src-genesis-kr-battery-notice: SK On, pouch, NCM). Applies to the 87.2 kWh pack of the 2023-2025 US/CA cars.

battery.nominal_voltage_class.notes: SAE Media article: 370 V nominal (hub motors on 370 V nominal), 109 kWh pack; 370 V is in the 400 V class.
Auto-Data.net: battery voltage 385 V for the TZ 450e 95.82 kWh. Toyota press release: 312 cells in this pack vs 104 in the 76.96 kWh pack (400 V class, src-insideevs-bz-charging-limit-2026).

battery.chemistry.notes: Estimated: platform sibling with the same pack. Lexus says the TZ 95.82 kWh pack is the Toyota Highlander EV 95.8 kWh pack (Toyota Liberty NC assembly); GreenCars reports LG Energy Solution pouch cells with nickel-manganese-cobalt-aluminum cathode (NMCA, recorded as nmc). Toyota states "lithium-ion" only (src-r2-lexus-tz-global-pr).
